I’ve been using this app for a few weeks now and it is exactly what I needed in a med tracker. It is customizable, allows you to track easily and accurately, adjust schedules, add new or one-time meds to your routine. Simple to set up, ease to use. And, astonishingly, you don’t even have to create an account if you don’t want your data backed up. In a world of semi-useful apps that just seem bent on adding you as a user, this one is a gem. 100% recommend

Clever and useful. Thank you. Multiple suggestions: 1) Enlarge and/or increase contrast of the tiny, tiny little icons at top; 2) add Meal as a category and ask for Start and Finish time. Reason for this one? People who take Carbidopa-Levodopa 3-5 times a day as I do benefit medically from timing meals 30-60 minutes before or after finishing a meal. Most meals contain protein which defeats C-L effectiveness. 3) Provide for simultaneous use of 2 strengths of same medication. 4) Provide for history of medication changes. I.E. when a doctor is honing in on the best dose, I have been told to take 1 pill of one strength and 2 of a different strength; then three days later take 2 & 2.
5) Provide for recording symptom/side-effects/interactions.

This app previously would auto calculate the next scheduled dosage, but now it only has the manual option which kinda sucks. For example I want to be able to tell it I’m taking a medication for 2 weeks everyday every 8 hours, starting on a Tuesday at 9am and have it adjust and auto tell me what time that is. I don’t like only having a manual input for each dose time.

title.label: Randomly changes dangerous dose and duration

content.label: Trying to taper off an prescription at 14 day intervals is too much for this app to handle. It will mix up the strength of the dose and change the dates you set to “as needed.” This is dangerous. Going back to paper, pen, and calendar. Too buggy to trust this app.

It’s the best app ever! I don’t forget my pills anymore which gives me a piece of mind
I just love this app…I had such a time keeping up with my med, being a Senior Citizen and having more med… this app is amazing!! 🤩

I recently had multiple illnesses that required several different medications, all needing to be spaced out different ways. Some I took a couple times a day, some I took five times a day and some four times a day. It was very confusing. But this app helped keep everything set for me. All I had to do was enter how many times a day I wanted to take it and put in the first dose and it figured out the schedule for me. It was great. I am so glad I had it.

I have been using Medisafe for 3 months. I have never been so consistent with my meds. The notification now brings me comfort because I know that I am actively taking care of myself. I have shared the app with my providers in hopes that they recommend it for their other patients. Download it nowww!!
